results.title: What are Queries? - Macrometa
results.snippet: # What are Queries? Queries are one of the fundamental concepts in computer programming and database management. Queries are used to search and retrieve data from a database based on certain criteria. Queries can be used to retrieve all records from a database or a subset of records that meet certain criteria, such as records that match a specific value in a certain field.
